name: JobSpy
description: Finds job listings and ranks them against an installation-local CV profile.
author: Evonic

variables.name: PROFILE_TEXT
variables.label: CV / Profile Text
variables.description: Paste the skills and experience used to rank jobs. This remains local to this Evonic installation.

variables.name: EXCLUSION_TERMS
variables.label: Exclusion Terms
variables.description: Comma-separated terms that should reduce a job's local match score.

variables.name: LOCAL_SCORE_THRESHOLD
variables.label: Local Score Threshold
variables.description: Minimum local score required before a job can be considered for model reranking.

variables.name: RERANK_ENABLED
variables.label: Enable Model Reranking
variables.description: Use Evonic's default model to rerank only the strongest local matches.

variables.name: RERANK_TOP_N
variables.label: Rerank Candidate Limit
variables.description: Maximum number of locally selected jobs sent to the model in one run.

variables.name: SUBPROCESS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
variables.label: Scrape Timeout (seconds)
variables.description: Maximum duration of one isolated JobSpy collection process.

variables.name: ALERT_AGENT_ID
variables.label: Alert Agent ID
variables.description: Evonic agent that sends qualifying job alerts.

variables.name: ALERT_EXTERNAL_USER_ID
variables.label: Alert Recipient ID
variables.description: External user identifier that receives qualifying job alerts.

variables.name: ALERT_CHANNEL_ID
variables.label: Alert Channel ID or Type
variables.description: Active channel UUID or channel type such as telegram or discord.
